translated_title: Claudia Sheinbaum Announces Cancellation of La Parota Dam in Guerrero; Water Wells Will Be Built Instead
original_title: CSP anuncia cancelación de presa La Parota en Guerrero; mejor se harán pozos de agua
author: Redacción/SinEmbargo
meta_description: After a two-decade grassroots fight against the CFE dam on the Papagayo River, the government will supply Acapulco with radial wells and tanks instead.
